dcterms:description: The MPQA 1.2 dataset includes two types of opinion expressions: direct subjective expressions (DSEs) and expressive subjective expressions (ESEs). DSEs represent both subjective speech events and explicitly mentioned private states, while ESEs consist of tokens that express emotion or sentiment in an indirect or implicit way.
dcterms:title: MPQA 1.2

dcterms:description: The NTCIR7-MOAT dataset is related to opinion expression and is organized by the NTCIR initiative. It is used for evaluating models in the context of opinion mining.
